note: The PUBLIC default layout. It names only the documented agent folders (11-Drills, 12-Readings, 90-Inbox) and Obsidian's own defaults: new notes at the vault root, and daily notes named YYYY-MM-DD. The owner's real layout, with the daily-notes folder, the filing targets and the journal, is PRIVATE: the engine writes it into each run record's layout, or passes it with --layout, and it never enters this repository.
